newsitem.title: CHINA: China '97 integrated circuit demand seen at 4 bln.
newsitem.headline: China '97 integrated circuit demand seen at 4 bln.

text.p: China's demand for integrated circuits is expected to reach four billion in 1997, the Economic Information Daily said on Friday.
Domestic demand for integrated circuits used in home electrical appliances was expected to rise sharply in 1997, the newspaper said, but gave no further details.
China's sales of personal computers were expected to hit 40 billion yuan ($4.8 billion) this year, up 60 percent on 1996, it said.
Demand for personal computers was expected to reach 2.4 million to 2.7 million in 1997, it said.
